purpose: Learn H1 received native damage separately for each currently observed enemy, with shared relative features and animation phase. Test predictive transfer before using a forecast to select dangerous TRAIN contexts. No actor/runtime update.
splits: Retain20TRAIN/8exploratory-development whole worlds and four challenge worlds excluded from fitting. Replay branches share world/frame weight. No map/seed/entityID/global position as NN input. Challenge has known zero H1incoming effects and cannot prove beneficial movement choice.
targets: For each first8distance-sorted root enemy, sum min(max(health_before,0),take) for available H1events targeting the actor with matching attacker ID and class. Remaining received damage is a separate unknown/remembered residual. Reconstruct exact total in every known row. Never assign an unseen attacker to a visible enemy.
input: 185 shared values per enemy: base12 + typed40 + ego self71 (yaw removed, own velocity rotated into ego axes) + equipped-weapon tail26 + actual-action context28 + masked animation sin/cos8. Action context includes source/final physical4 each,attack,mode2,vertical3,weapon12,selected-target flag,no-target flag. Animation periods4/8/16/32frames are generic encodings, not monster attack rules. No future duration input in a one-step forecast.
ablation: Same weights/batches/steps, but zero animation present/frame and all8phase encodings in shared_no_phase. Other typed/kinematic/action inputs unchanged.
aggregation: Node sigmoid damage-event probability and softplus expected HP. Mask absent slots. Total mean=sum visible means+TRAIN unknown mean, capped at observed health; event probability uses union of node probabilities and TRAIN unknown event rate. Unknown constants use TRAIN only. H1forecast necessarily identical for identical state/action regardless of later option duration.
loss: Equal blend of mean visible-node BCE+amount MSE(/20) and aggregate actor BCE+amount MSE(/20). Sample root rows with balanced world/frame weights. No positive-class resampling or target-derived context replacement.
baselines: TRAIN per-observed-type node event rates/means plus TRAIN unknown residual, and the previous frozen flat state-action H1head on exactly the same rows. Report no-phase ablation separately, no choosing a checkpoint or variant after outcomes.
challenge: Report H1alternative-control mean predicted HP deltas against observed zero effects for all4held-out worlds. Require short/long same-root-action equality as an architectural sanity check. This is not evidence that the model can rank evasive maneuvers under active fire.
next: If predictive admission passes, collect fresh source-policy cases and observable under-fire TRAIN contexts, then verify both predictive transfer and nonzero counterfactual action effects before any runtime action selection. Otherwise preserve negative results and inspect input/label timing or data coverage, not a larger blind fit.
storage: Compressed NPZ per-case chunks, original captures unchanged.
